name: Colorado Learning Attitudes about Science Survey
description: Agree/disagree statements about a science discipline and about learning it. Responses are compared with answers from experts in the field, so scores show how expert-like a student's beliefs are. Often given pre/post to see how a course shifts beliefs. Has discipline-specific versions.

construct_mapping.note: Recorded by maintainers; awaiting governance committee review.

original_citation.text: Adams, W. K., Perkins, K. K., Podolefsky, N. S., Dubson, M., Finkelstein, N. D., & Wieman, C. E. (2006). New instrument for measuring student beliefs about physics and learning physics: The Colorado Learning Attitudes about Science Survey. Physical Review Special Topics - Physics Education Research, 2(1), 010101.

access.terms_summary: Survey, answer key, scoring tool and implementation guide are downloadable from PhysPort; other discipline versions are linked from the CU Boulder SEI site. Republishing terms are not stated, so link rather than copy.

scoring.notes: Each item has an expert-consensus answer. Scores are percent of items answered in the expert-like (favorable) direction, overall and by category. PhysPort provides an answer key and scoring tool.

citation.text: Adams, W. K., Perkins, K. K., Podolefsky, N. S., Dubson, M., Finkelstein, N. D., & Wieman, C. E. (2006). Physical Review Special Topics - Physics Education Research, 2(1), 010101.

Adams, W. K., Wieman, C. E., Perkins, K. K., & Barbera, J. (2008). Modifying and validating the Colorado Learning Attitudes about Science Survey for use in chemistry. Journal of Chemical Education, 85(10), 1435.

dimensions.name: Problem Solving Sophistication
dimensions.notes: Categories were derived with the developers' reduced-basis factor analysis; items can load on more than one category. Some items belong to no category.
